name: Ascensive Educare Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Ascensive Educare Ltd is in the business of providing skill development training services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AEL is in the business of training and skill development. It offers vocational training, and educational consulting in collaboration with Central Government, State Governments and Industry Associations. Company provides training ranging from conducting training workshops to placement.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 153 days to 100 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 223 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -20.7%
